items.headline: Low Water Advisory issued November 26 at 12:04PM CST until November 26 at 7:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Abnormally low water levels.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Below normal water levels will result in hazardous
navigating conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...One additional low water advisory may be
needed around the low tide cycle on Friday.
items.instruction:
Mariners should navigate shallow waters with extreme caution due
to below normal water levels.
